messages:
sam: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last night's cross-region LB/TLS retry surge. Want owners + target dates for remediation items. TL;DR: retry storm correlated with long-tail TLS handshakes + conntrack exhaustion.

maria: I can take the routing debounce tune and prefix-caching check. Plan: add 200ms debounce on the route-change path and surface metrics. Target EOD Wed.

alex: I'll own conntrack pool increase + e2e smoke. Proposed immediate hotfix: bump conntrack hashsize, and follow with a proper capacity test. Hotfix today, regression test Thu.

raj: I'll pick up the cert-fallback logic — ensure we failover to compatible cipher suites instead of aborting. I'll draft a canary plan and have a test cert rotation run tomorrow.

jen: I'll coordinate rollout windows with infra and document the rollback knobs. Also will add the alert for TLS handshake error rate > 0.5% in prod. Goal: rollout Fri morning.

ops_oncall: Adding logs we saw during the spike:
```
[2026-03-22T23:41:02Z] LB: tls: handshake timeout for client ip=10.12.4.7
[2026-03-22T23:41:02Z] conntrack: new conn failed: table full, conn 98765
[2026-03-22T23:41:03Z] route: route-change flood for service=web-edge region=eu-west-1
```
Noting many short-lived flows, likely around our retry backoff falling back to fast retries.

sam: Useful. Can we capture a pcap for one of the affected load balancer nodes for the next incident window? ops_oncall, can you add packet capture playbook link? @deploy-bot can we tag the node group?

ops_oncall: Added playbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/playbooks/pcap-capture
Tagged node group: lb-eu-west-1-prod-rotary

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by jen for conntrack-hotfix branch. CI checks passing. ETA ~ 35m. :rocket:

maria: For the debounce change I'll add a metric: `route.debounce.count` and `route.debounce.latency_ms`. Will add a dashboard and create an eval shard to ensure we don't regress latency for streaming requests.

alex: Hotfix plan:
1) immediate: increase conntrack hashsize and gc threshold (rollout canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%)
2) followup: benchmark with long-tail TCP open/close (k6 + synflood profile)
I'll put the PR and test checklist in the issue.

raj: Cert fallback plan: add compatibility matrix and fallback to TLS1.2 when TLS1.3 handshake fails with specific cipher errors. Will also alert when fallback rate > 0.1%.

jen: Consolidated action items (I'll own the tracker):
- Routing debounce (owner: maria) — due: 2026-03-25
- Conntrack immediate fix (owner: alex) — due: 2026-03-23 (hotfix)
- Conntrack capacity test (owner: alex) — due: 2026-03-26
- Cert-fallback + canary (owner: raj) — due: 2026-03-24
- Rollout + alerting (owner: jen) — due: 2026-03-27

sam: Nice. One more thing — recurring pattern detection: ops, can you add a recurring query to the incident trends dashboard that flags cross-region retry spikes by origin-region / dest-region within 10m windows? Need an automated weekly digest for infra leads.

ops_oncall: Added a scheduled query: `cross_region.retry_spike` runs every 15m and posts digest to #incidents-weekly. I also added an alert annotation to the postmortem.

maria: I'll add a small smoke test to call random prefixes and ensure route-change rate stays below threshold during rollout. PR coming shortly.

alex: After hotfix I'll run the k6 profile and post results in this thread.

raj: Putting the cert fallback PR link here when ready. Also reaching out to CDN partner about observed cipher mismatches.

sam: Great, thanks everyone. Jen please share the tracker link when ready and ping me if any owner slips on the due dates. We'll review in Monday's incident retro.

jen: Tracker: https://go.redwood/issue/INC-4521

sam: Closing for now — will reopen if we see any post-rollout regressions. :white_check_mark:
